name: OpenPost
tagline: Create, adapt, schedule, and track social content with agents.
description: OpenPost is a social publishing workspace for creating, adapting, scheduling, publishing, and tracking content across connected social accounts. Its HTTP API, MCP server, and CLI share the same workspace, scope, validation, and provider-readiness rules.

methods.label: MCP OAuth
methods.note: OAuth-aware MCP clients can request mcp:read or mcp:full and bind access to one workspace.

methods.label: OpenPost API token
methods.note: Revocable bearer tokens use interface-specific scopes and can be limited to one workspace.

auth.guide:
**Hosted MCP:** point an OAuth-aware client at the Hosted endpoint. Request `mcp:read` for inspection or `mcp:full` for changes, then approve the connection in OpenPost. Bind it to one workspace when possible.

```txt
https://app.openpost.social/mcp
```

**HTTP API:** create a token in **Settings → Personal → Developer access**. Use `api:read` or `api:write`; MCP and CLI scopes do not grant generic REST access. The token is shown once and expires within one year.

```bash
curl https://app.openpost.social/api/v1/workspaces \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPENPOST_TOKEN"
```

**CLI:** install the release binary, sign in through a browser, then select a workspace. The CLI stores its `cli:full` token in the operating-system keyring by default.

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/getopenpost/openpost/main/scripts/install-cli.sh | sh
openpost auth login https://app.openpost.social
```

Use a separate credential per client, choose the narrowest scope, and revoke access when the client no longer needs it.

interfaces.name: OpenPost MCP server
interfaces.note: OAuth and manual tokens support mcp:read or mcp:full; access can be bound to one workspace.

interfaces.name: OpenPost HTTP API
interfaces.note: Use api:read or api:write. MCP and CLI token scopes are separate contracts.

interfaces.name: OpenPost CLI
interfaces.note: Browser or device login creates a cli:full token for the selected OpenPost instance.
